content:
Thanks for the explanation! Yes, our Chrome DevTools MCP server is pre-configured and expects to find the `DevToolsActivePort` file in the default Chrome user data directory (`C:\Users\SUPERUSUARIO\AppData\Local\Google\Chrome\User Data\DevToolsActivePort`). I do not have a tool to customize this path or connect directly via a custom WebSocket URL.

Therefore, the best path forward is indeed to ask the user to close all existing Chrome processes and then start Chrome with the debugging port using the default profile path so that the `DevToolsActivePort` file is written to the expected location. 

Please let me know once this is done and Chrome is ready!
